# Request Tracker Community Forum

> > Official community forum for Request Tracker (RT) and Request Tracker for Incident Response (RTIR) by Best Practical Solutions

This forum serves as the primary support and discussion platform for RT users, developers, and administrators. It covers installation, configuration, customization, email integration, API development, and incident response workflows using RTIR.

## Key Topics

- Request Tracker (RT)
- Request Tracker for Incident Response (RTIR)
- Best Practical Solutions
- RT configuration and customization
- Email integration and scrips
- Queue management and permissions
- RT API and webhooks
- Incident response workflows
- RT upgrades and releases
- Email signatures and templates
- Office 365 integration
- Community support and troubleshooting
- RT Users category
- RT Developers category
- Knowledge base and documentation

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [Request Tracker Community Forum - Top Discussions](https://forum.bestpractical.com/top): Top discussions on RT 6.0 releases, upgrades, and troubleshooting
- [About - Request Tracker Community Forum](https://forum.bestpractical.com/about): RT/RTIR forum overview with admins, moderators, and site statistics
- [FAQ - Request Tracker Community Forum](https://forum.bestpractical.com/faq): FAQ covering discussion etiquette and moderation policies for RT forum
- [Help for beginner - RT Users](https://forum.bestpractical.com/faq): Beginner guide request for RT3 setup, queues, scrips, and mail handling

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Queue not be loaded - Permissions Troubleshooting](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/queue-not-be-loaded/32040/2): Troubleshooting queue permissions and SeeQueue errors in RT
- [O365/Fetchmail - Email Integration](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/o365-fetchmail/31447): Office 365 IMAP integration with RT using Fetchmail and shared mailboxes
- [Removing user signature](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/removing-user-signature/37091/7): Discussion on removing email signatures and images from incoming tickets
- [About signatures - Email Templates](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/about-signatures/30520): HTML email signatures and quoted text handling in RT templates
- [Problem with email FROM/SENDER fields](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/problem-with-email-from-sender-fields/8470): Email header configuration issues with QMAIL and RT sender fields
- [Knowledge Base Software](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/knowledge-base-software/35932): Request for RT knowledge base plugin for FAQ and ticket deflection

## API & Development

- [API notifications - Custom Scrips](https://forum.bestpractical.com/t/api-notifications/33900): Custom scrips for API notifications via webhooks and external integrations
